categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Resolution of the fine case through early or timely payment before coercive enforcement or appeals. Advances 'Maximize timely fine revenue' (Make +100) and 'Minimize administrative & enforcement cost' (Help +50). Evaluated against Indicator id=114 (Average time to case closure) and Indicator id=112 (Time to fine dispatch).
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=12. Realized in the narrative sample by variants such as V0002, V0003, V0007, where payment occurs directly after fine creation or sending without entering penalty or appeal paths.

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Resolution of the fine case through payment occurring after penalties or notifications have been applied, but prior to full coercive credit collection. Helps 'Maximize timely fine revenue' (Help +50). Evaluated against Indicator id=114 (Average time to case closure).
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=13. Realized in the narrative sample by variants such as V0004, V0005, V0006, and V0009, where payment happens after 'Insert Fine Notification' and 'Add penalty'.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Resolution through an administrative appeal process directed to the Prefecture. Preserves offender's due-process rights (Help +50) while incurring administrative costs and delaying revenue (SomeNegative -25). Evaluated against Indicator id=113 (Time to appeal filing, Prefecture) and Indicator id=114.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=14. Realized in the narrative sample by variants like V0008, V0057, and V0137, featuring activities such as 'Insert Date Appeal to Prefecture' and 'Send Appeal to Prefecture'.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Resolution through a judicial appeal brought before a Judge. Fully supports offender's due-process rights (Make +100) but hurts administrative and enforcement costs (Hurt -50) and fine revenue (SomeNegative -25). Evaluated against Indicator id=175 (Time to appeal filing, Judge) and Indicator id=114.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=19. Realized in the narrative sample by variants such as V0103, V0140, V0176, and V0224, which explicitly include the 'Appeal to Judge' activity.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Resolution of the case through coercive credit collection measures after standard resolution pathways have failed or expired. Helps timely revenue (Help +50) but hurts administrative costs (Hurt -50) and due-process rights (SomeNegative -25). Evaluated against Indicator id=114 (Average time to case closure).
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=20. Realized in the narrative sample by variants such as V0001, V0009, and V0134, where the final outcome activity is 'Send for Credit Collection'.
